/subscribed/subtitle.v: Reba muri email zawe winjiye usange email yo kwemeza.

/form/intro.v: Nomero nshya zigera kuri email yawe, zanditse mu rurimi uhitamo.

/form/nameHint.v: Turarikoresha tugusuhuza. Niba urisize ubusa, dukoresha intangiriro ya aderesi ya email yawe.

/form/languageHint.v: Twabihisemo duhereye ku igenamiterere rya mushakisha yawe.

/form/consent.v: Iyo wiyandikishije, wemera kwakira email ziturutse kuri {sender}. Buri email ifite umurongo wo guhagarika kwiyandikisha.

/success/body.v: Twohereje email yo kwemeza kuri {email}. Yifungure uhitemo Emeza kwiyandikisha.

/success/next.v: Nomero yawe ya mbere izagera nyuma yo kwemeza, yanditse mu {language}.

/success/spam.v: Niba nta kintu kigeze mu minota mike, reba muri spam cyangwa Promotions.

/errors/emailInvalid.v: Iyi aderesi ya email isa n'ituzuye. Yigenzure wongere ugerageze.

/errors/missingLink.v: Uyu murongo wo kwiyandikisha ubura amakuru. Saba uwohereje umurongo mushya.

/errors/notFound.v: Uyu murongo wo kwiyandikisha ntugikora. Saba uwohereje umurongo mushya.

/errors/limit.v: Iki kinyamakuru ntigishobora kwakira abiyandikisha bashya ubu. Ongera ugerageze nyuma.

/errors/invalid.v: Ntitwashoboye kwakira iyi aderesi. Yigenzure wongere ugerageze.

/errors/server.v: Ntitwashoboye kubika kwiyandikisha kwawe. Ongera ugerageze mu kanya.

/errors/network.v: Ntitwashoboye kugera kuri seriveri. Genzura murandasi yawe wongere ugerageze.

/confirm/body.v: Hitamo buto kugira ngo utangire kwakira nomero kuri {email}.

/confirm/consent.v: Iyo wemeje, wemera kwakira iki kinyamakuru kuri email. Ushobora guhagarika kwiyandikisha uhereye kuri nomero iyo ari yo yose.

/confirm/successTip.v: Kugira ngo zitajya muri spam, ongeraho uwohereza mu bo muvugana.

/confirm/invalidBody.v: Ongera ufungure email yo kwemeza uhitemo buto yayo. Niba utayibona, ongera wiyandikishe uhereye ku paji y'uwohereza.

/confirm/notFoundBody.v: Ntitwabonye kwiyandikisha kw'iyi aderesi. Ongera wiyandikishe uhereye ku paji y'uwohereza.

/confirm/errorBody.v: Ntitwashoboye kwemeza kwiyandikisha kwawe. Ongera ugerageze mu kanya.

/embed/title.v: Ongeraho ifishi yo kwiyandikisha ku rubuga rwawe

/embed/intro.v: Shyira imwe muri izi kode ku rubuga rwawe. Abiyandikisha babona email yo kwemeza, hanyuma bakabona nomero zawe mu rurimi rwabo.

/embed/linkHint.v: Usangize muri bio y'imbuga nkoranyambaga, umukono wa email, cyangwa kode ya QR.

/embed/scriptHint.v: Yishyire aho ifishi igomba kugaragara. Ifishi yihindurira ingano ubwayo.

/embed/iframeHint.v: Koresha iyi niba urubuga rwawe rutemera script.

/embed/accentHint.v: Bireke uko biri kugira ngo ukoreshe ibara ry'ikirango cyawe.

/embed/previewNote.v: Iri garagaza rirakora by'ukuri. Kwiyandikisha hano bikora uwiyandikishije nyawe.

/embed/missing.v: Banza ukore ikinyamakuru. Ifishi yo kwiyandikisha izagaragara hano nikimara kubaho.

/signature/intro.v: Abasomyi babona ibi ku iherezo rya buri nomero. Kanda ku gice icyo ari cyo cyose cy'igaragaza ngo ugihindure.

/signature/show.v: Erekana umukono wanjye muri buri nomero

/signature/showHint.v: Niba uwuzimije, nomero zirangirira nyuma y'inkuru.

/signature/previewEmpty.v: Umukono wawe nta kintu urimo. Ongeraho izina ryawe kugira ngo utangire.

/signature/blocksHint.v: Hitamo tagi kugira ngo werekane cyangwa uhishe icyo gice. Ibice byahishwe bigumana inyandiko yabyo.

/signature/hints/photoUrl.v: Umurongo ujya kuri PNG cyangwa JPG ya kare, nibura pigiseli 144 kuri 144 kandi itarenze 200 KB. Igaragara ingana na pigiseli 72 kuri 72 iruhande rw'izina ryawe.

/signature/hints/logoUrl.v: Umurongo ujya kuri PNG cyangwa JPG ifite inyuma igaragaza cyangwa yera, nibura pigiseli 64 z'uburebure. Igaragara ifite uburebure bwa pigiseli 32.

/signature/hints/cta.v: Inyandiko n'umurongo byombi birakenewe kugira ngo buto igaragare.

/signature/hints/disclaimer.v: Inyandiko nto hasi, urugero icyitonderwa cy'ibanga. Bisige ubusa niba utabikeneye.

/signature/style/accentHint.v: Rikoreshwa ku murongo, imirongo ihuza na buto. Ritangirana n'ibara ry'ikirango cyawe.

/signature/resetConfirm.v: Ongera uhitemo kugira ngo usibe ibisabwa byose
